notes: INSIDE half of the Emberkin Pyre Lance: a brass boiler drum above a firebox whose flames climb with the charge (frame 5 = tall white-tipped flames, strip yellow), power coupling, brass hatch, a pipe to the right. fire: the firebox flashes white and the flames drop. damaged: the boiler seam cracked and weeping steam-fire, two lamps dead; disabled: cold firebox, the drum split, a pipe hanging. Barrel layer emberkin_pyre_lance_barrel: a long slim brass lance with cooling rings, a flared burner nozzle and a pilot flame; fire: a roaring jet. COMPACT (tier 1-2 parts take less room inside): this inside half is the centre of the original art between its own edge columns, re-outlined (art/_src/compact.py).
